# sks3200_port_vlan (Resource)

A port's PVID (the VLAN for untagged ingress) and accepted frame types. Destroying it resets the port to PVID 1, all frames.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sks3200_vlan_8021q" "guest" {
  vlan_id        = 20
  untagged_ports = [3]
}

# Referencing the VLAN orders destroy: the PVID resets to 1 before VLAN 20
# goes away.
resource "sks3200_port_vlan" "p3" {
  port            = 3
  pvid            = sks3200_vlan_8021q.guest.vlan_id
  accepted_frames = "untagged"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (Number) Port number, 1-based.
- `pvid` (Number) VLAN assigned to untagged frames arriving on the port. The port must be a member of it.

### Optional

- `accepted_frames` (String) One of "all" (default), "tagged" or "untagged".

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The port number.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Port number.
terraform import sks3200_port_vlan.p3 3
```
